disclosure: Autonomously AI-generated screenshot manifest; each capture has a bounded evidence claim.

items.caption: Build journal after scaffold and action-contract acceptance: four reference tasks and two setup tasks accepted. Actual browser capture; not Mixxx or DJ runtime proof.
Seven foundation tasks and both setup tasks accepted. The live browser updated without reload; all seven delivery gates remain open. This is a build-journal screenshot, not Mixxx playback evidence.
Actual Mixxx 2.5.6 audio preferences: 48 kHz, 5.33 ms buffer and built-in stereo output. Settings evidence, not playback or measured latency proof.
Actual Mixxx AI DJ virtual device with a route-only diagnostic mapping enabled. A fixed MIDI probe returned on the separate feedback channel; performance controls remain to build.

Foundation gate accepted; three MIDI tasks in progress. The browser refreshed automatically to show 13 accepted reference cards and four accepted expansion tasks. This is the build journal, not a MIDI performance test.

Actual Mixxx controller view after replacing the temporary ports with the TypeScript lifecycle adapter. The enabled diagnostic mapping returned the fixed MIDI reply. Performance controls and physical-controller handover still need implementation and testing.
Actual Mixxx loaded the AI DJ bootstrap and XML command registration. Native initialization/reload succeeded; performance fragments are not installed yet.
Actual Mixxx loaded the four assembled control/feedback fragments. Native initialization and initial feedback were observed; playback, timing and musical tests remain pending.
Actual build journal with 22 reference tasks and eight expansion tasks accepted. The separate communicator CLI is in progress; native reconnection and performance tests remain pending.
Actual enabled AI DJ mapping after service feedback recovery. All nine initial control readings became fresh; M12 separately verified play, both deck volumes and crossfader against native widgets.

Actual Mixxx AI DJ mapping enabled during two successful extended MIDI diagnostic round trips. Packet captures verify numeric and Unicode text payloads; the screenshot shows mapping state. Production clock, malformed-input and performance acceptance remain pending.

Actual custom Mixxx 2.7 development build running with its separate profile: 48 kHz and 21.3 ms buffer. Native script tests passed; application mapping clock probe and latency acceptance remain pending.

Actual browser view of the native reply lifecycle results: cancellation, MIDI reset, real input overflow and mapping shutdown stopped queued replies. The chart summarizes measured diagnostic packets; it is not a musical or physical-controller performance test.
Actual native cue marker after manual placement in the initial single-record run. Cue edges arrived, but sustained refresh traffic caused 874 explicitly reported drops; this run motivated batching.

Actual native cue marker at 1:31.12 during the corrected batched run. Capture verified full numeric cue position and press/release edges, with 15,670 observations and zero gaps. This is transport evidence, not musical or controller acceptance.
Native deck-one raw MIDI preview held: play lit, waveform advanced and meters active. Capture confirms play/preview true during the eight-second hold.
Native deck-two raw MIDI preview held with the batched observer running. Capture confirms play/preview true during the eight-second hold.
Both decks paused after raw MIDI cue release. Capture confirms play and preview zero, exactly four intended commands, and no extra incoming MIDI commands.
Native mouse play action: deck-one playback and returned play state changed before any companion MIDI command. Volume and fader changes were captured separately.
Native manual volume and crossfader moves with a newly placed cue marker. Feedback recorded volume 48/127, crossfader 113/127, cue position and separate default-button edges.
Native mouse sync tap changed tempo to 102 BPM, then the sync flag returned off. A final false sync flag does not mean no tempo action occurred.
Sustained MIDI sync lit on the native UI. It remained true for 6.79 seconds until manual cancellation, with no companion reassertion.

Final native handoff: both decks paused, sync off, volumes restored, crossfader centered and deck-one tempo back to 117 BPM. This completes initial five-control agreement, not latency or musical acceptance.
Native idle timing test: empty, paused decks while MIDI commands move deck-one volume. The screenshot shows the test state, not an audio-latency measurement.
Idle-test sound configuration verified after sampling: Core Audio, 48 kHz, 21.3 ms audio buffer. This is configuration evidence, not measured audio response.
Native Mixxx during the CPU-loaded MIDI test. Empty, paused decks and moving volume use the same profile as the idle measurement. Separate workload telemetry is retained in the run report.
After the loaded run, native preferences still show Core Audio at 48 kHz with the same 21.3 ms buffer. Zero underflows were reported by the native diagnostics.
Native volume down: actual fader pixels match returned MIDI state; conservative visible-by bound 102.49 ms.
Native volume up in trial 9: matching pixels and MIDI feedback, but a 191.96 ms capture bound leaves the 150 ms target unresolved.
